svg.aria-label: Modern periodic table coloured by s p d f blocks
svg.title: Modern Periodic Table — Coloured by s/p/d/f Blocks
svg.desc: The 18-group long-form periodic table, with each element rendered as a small tile showing atomic number and symbol. Tiles are coloured by block: s-block (groups 1–2 plus He) in blue, p-block (groups 13–18 minus He) in orange, d-block (groups 3–12) in green, f-block (lanthanides + actinides) in purple. The two f-block rows sit below the main table.
svg.text: Modern Periodic Table — Coloured by Block (s · p · d · f)
Each block names the subshell where the last electron lands. The table's shape is the shape of orbital filling.
